title: Independent verification: selected PR1042 replay-capsule closure (no new κ)
body:
This adds an independent, standard-library audit of the frozen PR1042 replay capsule. The historical selected record is now frozen inside the package, so verification succeeds at the submitted head and after newer results replace the live selected pointer. No new construction or kappa is claimed.

The update addresses [Doug Colkitt's review](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1142#issuecomment-6161606512):

- `SELECTED-RESULT.json` preserves the original record from `ba82555c64e1879e4b7decce28186f208fcb8262` byte for byte, with its original SHA-256 `207d1f49f113c585024b9d3c17eadbb8b1be17c1321e3d190aabe2f18ce1c5b7`.
- The historical verifier reads package-local data. Current selected-pointer validation remains the separate `selected-record-check` target.
- The documented `frontier1042-capsule-closure-verify` Makefile target is included. It compares normal and optimized verifier receipts against the committed `RESULT.json` and runs nine tests in both modes.
- Regression tests require the complete audit to pass with the live pointer missing or advanced, and to reject a corrupted frozen record. The promoted-receipt negative control now exercises actual verifier rejection.
- The accidentally bundled `compact-boundary-cancellation-seed51` package is removed from this PR, eliminating the overlap with #1108 identified in #1654.

The audit authenticates 458 safe regular archive members, 45,647,427 expanded bytes, all 457 declared artifact digests, exact inventory closure, ten stage/log bindings, six promoted receipts, and the historical selected/integration publication pins. Selected kappa: `1672188119205421 / 10^18`. Assignment seed: 75.

## Reproduce

```sh
make frontier1042-capsule-closure-verify
```

Expected: `PASS_FRONTIER1042_CAPSULE_CLOSURE` and nine passing tests in each Python mode. Direct Python commands are documented in the package README.

## Validation

All four Python commands in the Makefile target passed on Windows at the updated PR head. Normal and optimized receipts match the original committed `RESULT.json` byte for byte. GNU make itself was unavailable locally; its recipe commands were executed directly.

The updated PR applies cleanly to main at `ae95f60feec79897b153dba6459bb3f9fd4d7b8e`. Both verifier modes, the nine-test suite, and the separate current `scripts/verify_selected_result.py` check passed in that trial checkout. `git diff --check` is clean.

## Scope and attribution

This is finite publication-evidence verification. It does not authenticate execution history, independently recompute construction mathematics, discharge inherited interfaces, prove analytic transfer, or formalize the multiplication theorem.

Contribution by Martin Rv (@martinxxx9), with substantial Perplexity AI assistance in the original research, implementation, verification, and writing. The historical-record portability fix, reproduction target, and regression controls were prepared with OpenAI Codex assistance. PR1042, batch1047, and predecessor construction/review attribution remain with their original contributors. New material is Apache-2.0.
